checklist.action: if --milestone given, use it; else read RETRO.md to find latest milestone with completed work but no retro entry
list merged PRs in milestone window via gh pr list and/or .pipeline-state/*.json completed_at
record pr_numbers in state file (top-level array)
output MILESTONE_IDENTIFIED with the milestone tag and PR count

2.name: Read per-PR retros
2._note: Per-PR retros may live as pr/feedback/retro-{N}.md OR as GitHub PR comments. Both must be checked. Skipping this step is the #1 way the milestone retro misses the technical-design lessons the per-PR retro author already extracted.

checklist.action: for each PR in pr_numbers: try pr/feedback/retro-{N}.md first; if missing, fetch GitHub PR retro comment via gh pr view <N> --json comments
if a PR has neither a file nor a comment retro: flag as RETRO_GATE_VIOLATION (the pipeline-run retro-artifact gate leaked); record in state and continue, but require backfill in stage 4
for each PR retro: extract What Worked Well, What Didn't Work, What to Improve, Knowledge Base Updates Needed, Recurring Issue Tracker
record per_pr_findings in state file (one entry per PR, keyed by PR number)
output PR_RETROS_READ with the count of retros found and the count of gate violations

3.name: Write milestone entry
3._note: Synthesize ACROSS PRs — don't just list each PR's findings separately. Aim for 3-6 milestone-level findings. Every finding gets an Action taken: line that will be classified in stage 3.5.

checklist.action: synthesize findings across PRs into 3-6 milestone-level findings
every finding has an explicit 'Action taken:' line
Insights / Review Stats / Process Improvements / Open Items sections written
record findings list in state file (one entry per finding with title and action_taken_text)
output MILESTONE_ENTRY_DRAFTED with finding count

3.5.name: Verification gate: classify Action taken: lines
3.5._note: THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING GATE. Writing prose in RETRO.md is Step 3 (synthesis). Filing actions is Step 4. If your Action taken: line is the prose itself, the action is missing — you cannot pass this gate by re-reading your own RETRO.md text and calling it an action. Every finding must classify as one of: diff | skill_update | tracker_row | closed. Anything else is prose_only and fails the gate.

checklist.action: for each finding in state.findings: classify Action taken: line as exactly one of: diff | skill_update | tracker_row | closed | prose_only
diff = a specific file:line + change description (e.g. 'Added _setFormPending helper at python/djust/static/djust/src/09-event-binding.js:127.'); commit must already exist or be queued for stage 6
skill_update = a specific path to a SKILL.md or CLAUDE.md plus the section heading edited
tracker_row = 'Open — tracked in Action Tracker #N (GitHub #NNN)' with both numbers present (filled in by stage 4)
closed = 'Closed — <reason>' where reason references a PR/commit/test that already covers it

prose_only = anything else: 'captured here as a milestone finding', 'pattern observation', 'documented in this retro', 'worth canonicalizing later', 'no code change' alone, 'pattern documented in CHANGELOG' without a diff reference, etc.
record action_classifications in state file (finding_index -> classification)

GATE: if any finding classifies as prose_only, the gate FAILS — do not advance to stage 4. Either (a) convert the finding to a tracker_row by filing it in stage 4 then return here, or (b) apply the change now (commit a diff) then re-classify, or (c) delete the finding from RETRO.md if it isn't worth either
output GATE_PASSED or GATE_FAILED with the indices of any prose_only findings

4.name: Update Action Tracker
4._note: Sources to scan for new actions: per-PR retro 'What to Improve' items, per-PR retro 'Knowledge Base Updates Needed' items, milestone findings classified as tracker_row in stage 3.5, and any generalizable framework patterns surfaced in per-PR retros that aren't already canonicalized.

checklist.action: for each per-PR 'What to Improve' item not already in the Action Tracker: add a row
for each per-PR 'Knowledge Base Updates Needed' item not already tracked: add a row
for each milestone finding classified as tracker_row in stage 3.5: add a row
for each generalizable framework pattern in per-PR retros not already in CLAUDE.md / PR checklist / framework docs: add a row OR canonicalize it inline this commit (then reclassify as diff)
for each new row: create GitHub issue with tech-debt label and record the issue number — gh issue create --title 'tech-debt: <summary>' --label tech-debt
record new_tracker_rows and new_github_issues in state file (one entry per row with row_number, source, github_issue_number)
for each previously-open tracker row resolved this milestone: close with PR/commit reference, record in closed_rows
deduplicate: items appearing in multiple sources merged into one row with combined Source field
for each RETRO_GATE_VIOLATION recorded in stage 2: backfill the missing PR retro by posting via gh pr comment <N> --body-file <retro>
for each tracker_row finding from stage 3.5: replace the prose Action taken: line in RETRO.md with 'Open — tracked in Action Tracker #N (GitHub #NNN)' using the actual numbers
output ACTION_TRACKER_UPDATED with counts (rows added, issues created, rows closed, retros backfilled)

4.5.name: Re-verify Action taken: lines
4.5._note: After stage 4 backfills tracker rows + issue numbers into the prose, re-run the stage 3.5 classification. No finding should classify as prose_only any more. If any do, stage 4 missed something.

checklist.action: re-classify every finding's Action taken: line
GATE: zero prose_only classifications — if any remain, return to stage 4
output REVERIFY_PASSED or REVERIFY_FAILED
scan previous milestones' Open Items for items resolved in this milestone (via PR or commit reference)
annotate resolved items with '— resolved in vX.Y.Z (PR #NN)'
output PREVIOUS_MILESTONES_UPDATED with count of resolved items
git add RETRO.md (and any other files touched: CLAUDE.md if updated, PR checklist if updated, etc.)
commit with conventional message: docs(retro): milestone vX.Y.Z + action tracker update
post-commit verification: git log -1 --oneline (Action #122 — confirm commit hash matches expected message)
git push origin <default-branch>
output RETRO_COMPLETE
